description: ops/soak/signal_outcomes.py scores money rather than events, so its failure modes are quiet: a unit mixed up, a boundary resolved the flattering way, unresolved trades dropped, or a control gate that cannot fail. Each mutation below is a way the 2026-10-10 analysis could have reported a plausible wrong number. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/signal_outcome_replay.json

mutations.name: a loss is charged one unit whatever the stop, so widening the stop reads as free
the ambiguous candle is resolved as a win, flattering every wide stop
every signal is treated as filled, so an untouched entry still takes the loss
mutations.old:
target_in_r = abs(target - signal.entry) / base
    live = False
mutations.new:
target_in_r = abs(target - signal.entry) / base
    live = True

mutations.name: the entry candle is judged for stop and target, so a tight stop closed through on its own fill reads as a loss the engine never records
unresolved trades are dropped instead of marked to the last close
the zero-R labels enter the expectancy denominator and pull it toward zero
the control gate cannot fail, so a drifted simulator still prints its table
no evidence reads as agreement, so an empty record passes the control
fewer candles are loaded than the sweep asks for, so long TTLs read as expired
concentration drops arbitrary trades instead of the best ones
